text: 11月11日，中国注册会计师协会党委书记、秘书长江湧在财政部新闻发布会上表示，“十五五”时期，中国注册会计师协会将紧紧围绕服务国家建设主题和诚信建设主线，着力推进行业规范化。协会将聚焦优化行业发展环境，协调推动企业进一步完善招投标等选聘评价体系，形成以质量为导向的会计事务所选聘机制，坚决整治行业“内卷式”竞争。
text_en: On November 11, Jiang Yong, Party Secretary and Secretary-General of the Chinese Institute of Certified Public Accountants (CICPA), said at a Ministry of Finance press conference that during the "15th Five-Year Plan" period, CICPA will closely focus on the theme of serving national development and the main thread of integrity building, and strive to advance industry standardization. The institute will focus on optimizing the industry development environment, coordinate efforts to help enterprises further improve bidding and other selection and evaluation systems, establish a quality-oriented selection mechanism for accounting firms, and resolutely curb "involution-style" competition in the industry.
